meta_description: Mint Garden Services is your trusted Leicester gardener for lawn care, planting, and garden maintenance. Professional, reliable, local. Call today.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to manicured lawns, Mint Garden Services brings your Leicester garden to life with care and expertise.
services_heading: Complete Garden Care Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: Whether you need a one-off tidy or regular maintenance, we handle every aspect of garden upkeep with attention to detail.

services.title: Regular Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly grass cutting, hedge trimming, and border tidying keep your garden looking sharp year-round. We tailor schedules to your needs and season.

services.title: Lawn Care & Treatment
services.desc: From scarifying and aeration to moss treatment and overseeding, we restore patchy lawns to lush, healthy growth.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Pruning
services.desc: Expert pruning and shaping of hedges, shrubs, and climbing plants — done safely and to keep your garden in shape.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Overgrown garden? We clear weeds, remove dead growth, and dispose of waste, leaving you a clean slate to work with.

services.title: Planting & Garden Design
services.desc: We source and plant perennials, shrubs, and seasonal bedding to add colour and structure to your borders.

services.title: Decking & Patio Maintenance
services.desc: Keep wooden decks and paved areas safe and attractive with cleaning, sealing, and repair work tailored to Leicester's climate.

about_pullquote: I do the work I'd want done in my own garden.
about_para_1: Mint Garden Services started over 15 years ago in Leicester with a simple idea: to deliver honest, reliable garden care without the premium prices. Since then, we've built a loyal customer base across the city, tackling everything from small suburban borders to larger landscaping projects. We're proud to be a local, hands-on business — you speak to the gardener who'll be at your property.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we turn up on time, listen to what matters to you, and get the job done without fuss. We don't oversell unnecessary work or push expensive treatments you don't need. Instead, we focus on keeping your garden healthy, attractive, and within budget. Many of our clients have been with us for a decade or more.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Gardeners Say About Mint

reviews.text: Had Mint come out for a complete garden overhaul in spring. The garden was a right mess — overgrown borders, moss everywhere. They cleared it all, laid new turf, and planted some lovely shrubs. Fair price, turned up when they said they would, and the results speak for themselves. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Been using Mint for regular maintenance for about 3 years now. They come fortnightly to cut the grass and tidy the beds. Never a fuss, reliable as clockwork, and my garden always looks great. They're a gem to have on speed dial.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Called them in August for a hedge trim that had got completely out of hand. Came round the next day, quoted fair, and did a brilliant job. The whole street noticed! Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: James M.
